fields.description: Group this user belongs to. Everything the group grants, this user reaches — on top of their own Allow below.
fields.label: Group

fields.description: total_tokens this user may consume per calendar month (UTC); blank/0 = unlimited. SHARED across every API Key they hold — the keys are just credentials, the budget is the person's. Enforced by the control plane against the month's Usage Records; when reached, all their keys are flagged rate_limited and pushed to the gateways (reactive, resets each month).
fields.label: Max Tokens / Month

fields.description: System-set: this user hit their monthly token budget, so every key they hold is rejected with 429 (their keys project status=rate_limited). Cleared by the daily grove.usage_pull.reactivate_rate_limited once current-month usage is back under budget (month rollover / raised budget); stays blocked for the rest of the month otherwise.
fields.label: Rate Limited

fields.description: Models for this user alone, on top of whatever their group grants. A user with no grants anywhere reaches no models.
fields.label: Allow

fields.description: Models this user may never call. Deny wins over everything — a group grant and a Public release both lose to it.
fields.label: Deny
